type: UI, API and source review; not full financial acceptance
changes: Review evidence only. No runtime fixes, deployment, external publication or financial transactions performed.

interactions: Launch draft identity and funding steps without signing
Boost package dialog and wallet gate without purchase
Mobile buy/sell sheet and disconnected disabled actions
limitations: Browser session was disconnected; authenticated signing flows were not repeated.
Pending-wallet reproduction used a mocked DOM with the real frontend module, without signing or network calls.
No claim that every contract instruction or every recovery branch was exercised.
No production-load, RPC failover or WebSocket soak benchmark was run in this review.
Snapshots include loading and settled states; rendering alone is not financial success evidence.

findings.title: Milestone buybacks advertised as available without the required price signer
findings.verification: Live UI, public capability API, finalized Devnet account read and source review
findings.impact: Users are told only funding and milestones remain, although execution cannot pass its mandatory signer configuration. No bypass or loss of funds was demonstrated.
findings.recommendation: Include price-service configuration and finalized signer-account verification in per-agent readiness; display the actual blocker. Keep execution paused until verified.

findings.title: Launch package cards promise X promotion while publishing is paused
findings.verification: Live launch funding step, public API and source review

evidence.visibleCardText: Auto post & promote project to app X page.
evidence.availabilityDisclosure: Only in title on cards; help and terms elements are created but not appended. A later review summary does include the pause.

findings.impact: The package selection screen overstates current service availability, especially on touch devices without hover disclosure.
findings.recommendation: Render the paused status beside package benefits and pricing, explain reserved budgets and delivery conditions, and retain the same status on the final review.

findings.title: One admin's saved pending withdrawal blocks another admin and unrelated sources
findings.verification: Reproduced locally with mocked DOM and real initAdminWithdrawals; source confirms destination-bound reconciliation
findings.impact: After reload or wallet/session switching in the same tab, the new admin cannot start an unrelated withdrawal. A finalized receipt for the other admin cannot be reconciled under the new admin's destination.
findings.recommendation: Scope pending records by network, admin and source. Preserve unresolved records and enforce source-level server locks without blocking unrelated sources.

findings.title: Withdrawal failures are not displayed beside the withdrawal controls
findings.verification: Source-confirmed error path; no new live failure transaction attempted
findings.impact: The catch path updates the global message near the top of the page while the withdrawal section can retain its earlier quote or pending text. A user at the withdrawal form can miss a signing/RPC error and mistake the quote for the result.
findings.recommendation: Use an inline status/error region beside Submit, preserve pending signature identity, and make preparation, signing, submission, confirmation and failure states explicit.

findings.title: Required Terms agreement points to an outline rather than completed service terms
findings.verification: Live Terms modal and source review; product content gap, not legal advice
findings.impact: Launch requires agreement, but the modal contains one responsibility paragraph, version/date metadata and a contents list with no corresponding sections.
findings.recommendation: Complete and review the actual service terms, including package delivery and recovery expectations, and keep the agreement linked to the applicable version.

remainingAcceptanceGaps: Fresh end-to-end X identity verification and payout to its bound wallet.
Milestone and protocol buyback purchase/burn with finalized debit, receipt and supply proof after the independent signer is activated.
Full scheduled holder payout and migration/airdrop lifecycle with actual recipient deltas.
Developer unlock expiry cases and paid-launch cancellation/recovery without a second burn.
Restart, wallet/session switch and interrupted receipt recording across financial flows.
Production identities, reviewed binary, isolated infrastructure, spending limits and capped Mainnet acceptance remain blocked in config/mainnet-acceptance-plan.json.

priorEvidence.note: Previously recorded finalized real-Phantom withdrawal evidence was inspected as context; it was not repeated during this review.
